unit: Simons Center for the Social Brain
notes: Cross-institutional funding/community hub, not a department of its own labs: its Investigators page lists 74 scientists and clinicians across MIT, Harvard, the Broad Institute and other Boston-area institutions who hold SCSB seed grants, targeted-project funding, or postdoctoral-mentor roles. These PIs' own labs are recorded (or will be recorded) under their home department's source file (e.g. Picower, BCS, Biology, MIT Media Lab, Broad Institute) -- not duplicated here to avoid double-counting. No SCSB-specific lab, admin contact beyond general center staff, or join page was captured in this pass.
